about_the_game:
In Blitzstrike you play as Trixel, a hot-headed bounty hunter with a sharp tongue and an even sharper aim. When a mysterious threat resurfaces, Trixel is thrust into a high-speed, high-stakes mission across a green neon-lit city, a long bridge, and even rooftops. Along the way, she faces off against deadly bots, tight spaces, and a vicious threat who might just be her deadliest rival—or her only way out.

                                            

Fast, frantic, and stylish, Blitzstrike blends tight 2D gunplay with cinematic moments, hidden paths, and an explosive climax. It’s a short, sweet, sharp blast of arcade action designed to be beaten in under an hour—but packed with enough secrets and style to keep speedrunners and explorers coming back for more.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU (Intel, AMD, or NVIDIA)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or discrete GPU (Metal support required)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Blitzstrike is a fast-paced 2D action-platformer where you play as Trixel, a sharp-tongued bounty hunter on a mission through a futuristic city and enemy-filled corridors, culminating in a dramatic showdown with her greatest threat yet.
